description: Turn a citizen's dates into exact calendar dates, with the correct day of the week, before you search or book. ALWAYS use this when a citizen gives a date — especially a bare one like 'June 16' or 'next Friday' — and do NOT work out the year or the weekday yourself (that is error-prone for you). Give the month and day; leave year off to get the next upcoming occurrence (this runs on the citizen's machine, so it knows today's real date). Add nights for a stay to get the departure date too. Use the start_date and end_date it returns verbatim in search_sites / search_park_availability / prepare_booking.

nights.description: Number of nights, to also compute the departure date.

year.description: Arrival year. Leave off for the next upcoming occurrence.

name: resolve_dates
title: Work out exact calendar dates
